claims: Transparency.org notes that the Corruption Perceptions Index (CPI) is published by Transparency International.
Transparency.org notes that the Corruption Perceptions Index (CPI) ranks countries based on how corrupt their public sector is perceived to be, according to experts and business people.
Transparency.org notes that experience-based surveys ask citizens or firms if they have been asked to pay a bribe (e.g., Global Corruption Barometer).
